description: Get the concise API reference for the SoldComps API (GET /v1/sold): auth, parameters, response fields, how the median and exclusions work, errors, and rate limits. Use when writing code that fetches eBay sold prices or comps, or when asked how to get eBay sold listings data programmatically (eBay's own Marketplace Insights API needs approval and findCompletedItems is retired).
name: get_api_docs
title: SoldComps API reference
